mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inbound_receipts ( warehouse_id, source_outbound_code, supplier_id, type, note, staff_id ) VALUES ( #{warehouseId}, #{sourceOutboundCode}, #{supplierId}, #{type}, #{note}, #{staffId} ) RETURNING id, receipt_code

INSERT INTO inbound_items ( inbound_id, sku_id, sku_code, product_name, quantity, import_price ) VALUES
( #{item.inboundId}, #{item.skuId}, #{item.skuCode}, #{item.productName}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.importPrice} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, inbound_id, sku_id, sku_code, product_name, quantity, import_price, line_total FROM inbound_items WHERE inbound_id = #{inboundId}
